# Revenue to Pipeline

`revenue-to-pipeline` · v1.0.0 · Design · Sales & Pipeline
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/revenue-to-pipeline/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** How many wins, opportunities, SQLs, MQLs and leads does this period's revenue target take per month, at our own rates, and which stage is furthest short?

**Inputs:** A revenue target for a period, the average deal size, the period length in months, and either stage-to-stage conversion rates or last period's counts at each stage; optionally revenue already expected from open pipeline, the sales cycle in days and current monthly volumes

**Output:** Wins, opportunities, SQLs, MQLs and leads needed, exact and rounded up, per period and per month; the monthly gap at each stage against current volume and the stage furthest short; when the top of the funnel has to be created

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill revenue-to-pipeline`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/revenue-to-pipeline/resources/pipeline-plan.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/revenue-to-pipeline/resources/pipeline-plan.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex (Windows, ab-test-significance only).

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- The plan is only as good as the rates, and the engine holds none of its own. Rates from one quarter can be noisy; use rates the team has held for two quarters where it can.
- Rates derived from last period's counts compare stages within the same period. Deals that crossed periods make them approximate; a cohort view is more exact.
- Revenue expected from open pipeline is the user's own figure and is subtracted as given. It should be a weighted forecast, not the full value of open deals.
- The lead time treats every deal as taking the same number of days. Real sales cycles vary.

**Review before acting:** The revenue or sales lead confirms the rates against the CRM for the same stage definitions, that the target and deal size are both new revenue, and that the expected figure from open pipeline is weighted.
